div.div: Everything except Nix, the Docker engine and WSL2 comes from the flake. just doctor fails if a tool on PATH is not from /nix/store, so a host copy of kind, kubectl or helm cannot shadow a pinned one. Runtime artifacts (chart, image, kind node image) are pinned in one versions file, tools by flake.lock and Python packages by uv.lock.
